_comment: Values declared in data that no code reads, accepted for now. The data->code check in validate_data.py fails on anything unread that is NOT listed here, so this file is the record of known gaps rather than a way to silence the check. Shrink it by wiring a consumer, never by adding a line without a reason.

base_bonuses stat._reason: Skill payouts with no consumer yet. Names now carry their own units and scope: `_pct` is a percentage, `party_` means one member's skill pays the whole party, a bare name is flat. That convention exists because the old names hid the difference — `movement_speed` reaching 65 looked like it belonged in `derived.movement`, which is measured in tiles. Two things are still missing before these can be wired: percentage-shaped consumers, and a party-wide propagation mechanism (the 'logistics train').

status effect._reason: Behaviour strings on statuses.json entries that no code interprets. Several are one-off mechanics on a single status; `knockback` gains a reader when forced movement lands.
